svg.title: Exact emitted disc and hole profile sweep, including tab retention
svg.desc: Blue is the full-depth endmill sweep parsed from the exact profile NC. Orange marks exact emitted tab-floor path segments retained at Z-2.55. Frame is a candidate 110 mm stock, not a measured setup.

g.text: Blue: exact full-depth cutter sweep; orange: outer tabs retained to Z-2.55
110 x 110 mm candidate stock; 100 mm disc, 4 mm hole; review only
